name: Mirabegron

protocolDosing.notes: FDA-approved 25–50 mg for overactive bladder; metabolic/BAT research uses 200 mg (4× approved max) — substantial CV risk (≥20 bpm HR increase); CYP2D6 inhibitor at all doses (raises metoprolol, digoxin)

effects: bladder detrusor relaxation (FDA indication: overactive bladder)
increased brown adipose tissue thermogenesis (metabolic research, supratherapeutic dose)
mild heart rate increase at approved doses
significant heart rate and BP increase at 200 mg

mechanismOfAction.summary: Selective β3-adrenergic receptor agonist; bladder relaxation at approved doses; BAT thermogenesis at supratherapeutic doses.
mechanismOfAction.description: Selective β3-AR agonist (β1/β2 sparing at approved doses); FDA-approved for overactive bladder via bladder detrusor relaxation. Activates brown adipose tissue thermogenesis and increases energy expenditure at supratherapeutic doses (200 mg). Tmax ~3.5 h; oral bioavailability 29–35% (food-dependent). Moderate CYP2D6 inhibitor — raises plasma levels of metoprolol, digoxin, and other CYP2D6 substrates.
